source.title: VNC OS Admin UX Overhaul — canonical program / master tracker
source.body:
# VNC OS Admin UX Overhaul — canonical program (29 Oct 2026)

**Single source of truth for Admin UX/UI, information architecture, navigation and workflow rollout.** All new Admin redesign tasks/PRs link here; do not create another parallel redesign initiative.

## Approved direction
Honeywell Forge-inspired, original VNC branding: compact enterprise operations workspace, high-information-density tables, clear prioritization, light canvas/navy navigation, responsive, accessibility and keyboard support. **Business logic, API, production records and existing permissions must remain intact. No destructive database migrations.**

## Existing work — reconcile, not duplicate
- PR #284 — admin visual foundation, reusable data workspace and module switcher; check current merge/CI state before proceeding.
- PR #286 — Customer/Orders scoped compact styling, **merged**; only a visual pass, not full UX overhaul.
- PR #281 — initial iframe-based Multi-Window; maintain while designing native panes.
- PR #270 — Customer↔Order linking; reconcile before editing related screens.
- Prior Customer 360 and Order Operations tasks #263 / #266: reuse existing work rather than rebuilding services.

## Release gates and prioritized work
### P0-A: IA, shell, RBAC, route registry
- Inventory all live /admin routes and map owner, required permission, list/detail/create/edit state.
- Single route registry for sidebar, breadcrumbs, active states and search.
- Remove misplaced menu items (bank transactions→Finance, suppliers→Sourcing/SRM, media/products→Products/CMS). No dead links.
- Compact desktop sidebar, responsive drawer, keyboard accessibility, clear breadcrumbs.
- Audit permission defaults and every API authorization (do not assume frontend flags secure endpoints).

### P0-B: Customer management
- Existing Customer list/detail only; real server-backed data.
- Compact searchable filterable sortable table; sales owner, follow-up, quick actions, pagination, empty/loading/error.
- Customer 360: contacts, recent activities, quotes, linked orders; preserve detail navigation and filters.
- Regression: authorized Customer→Orders→Customer, non-privileged role, edit/save, no accidental data loss.

### P0-C: Order management
- Existing Order list/detail/quick-entry; no forked implementation.
- Dense table: status, value, assigned staff, deadlines and links to customers; filters and saved view where supported.
- Order detail workspace: items, production milestones, shipping and documents.
- Quick Entry: remove tall blank rows, align size/color grid, keyboard navigation, validation, sticky summary, mobile fallback.
- Regression: customer order linking, order create/edit and totals preserved exactly.

### P1: Remaining modules
CRM Lead/Inbox; RFQ/Quotation/Costing; Production/Technical/QC/Delivery; SRM/Sourcing; Finance; Products/Multi-Site CMS/Marketing; Settings/Reports.

### P2: Platform-wide polish
Native split-pane / Multi-Window, saved views, accessibility audit, responsive QA, empty/error/permission states, performance.

## Mandatory Definition of Done per module
- Authenticated desktop + mobile screenshots, tested with real role permissions.
- No fake KPI/live data, no deleted fields or broken workflows.
- Typecheck, lint, tests, security checks, Next.js build pass.
- PR has exact SHA, independent review findings P0–P3 resolved, verified Vercel preview and production smoke.
- Production deploy verified by deployment READY + correct domain alias; rollback ready.
- Update this issue with changed paths, QA evidence, deployment URL, issues/limitations.

## Execution order
**Navigation → Customer List/Detail → Order List/Detail → Quick Order → Commercial → Operations → CMS/Finance/System.**
No cosmetic-only PR may be described as completed business UX.
